name: Splash!
source:
Kaito, who wants to be a professional sport trainer, works at a school as a practice coach. One day, three girls suddenly tell him that they love him. To decide his girlfriend, they agree to have a battle. Kaito tries to cool them down, but they start approaching him...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
海斗梦想成为职业体育教练，目前在一所学校担任实习教练。一天，3名女孩突然向他告白。为了决定谁能成为他的女朋友，她们同意通过比赛一决胜负。海斗试图让她们冷静下来，但女孩们却开始主动接近他…

[摘自ErogeShop]
